Container.Name: wolfet-wasm
Container.Overview: Play Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory in a web browser. Runs a WebAssembly/WebGL 2 client and a shared ET: Legacy Objective server with official maps, optional Omni-Bot population, custom PK3 support, and automatic idle sleep.
Container.Description: Open the WebUI after installation, enter a player name, and press Play. On first start the container downloads the official free Enemy Territory game data from Splash Damage, verifies its pinned checksums, and stores it under /data. Add custom maps by placing compatible PK3 files in /data/custom_maps, then restart the container. The image supports amd64 hosts only.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Wolfenstein Enemy Territory ET Legacy browser WebAssembly WebGL game server
Container.Requires: An amd64/x86_64 Unraid host and outbound internet access on first start to obtain the official game data.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent official game data, generated configuration, bans, and custom_maps PK3 drop folder.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Browser game, WebSocket proxy, health, and status HTTP port.

Config.Name: Enemy Territory UDP
Config.Description: Native Enemy Territory dedicated-server query and connection port. Browser gameplay uses the Web UI port.

Config.Name: Game Mode
Config.Description: arcade enables faster movement, double jump, unlimited stamina, hit sounds, and the optional visibility/targeting layer. vanilla uses stock-style movement and disables those additions.

Config.Name: Match Population
Config.Description: Human-plus-bot population maintained by the server; enter an integer from 2 through 63.

Config.Name: Keep Server Alive
Config.Description: Set true to keep the dedicated match running indefinitely. When false, only the lightweight web host remains active while idle.

Config.Name: Idle Timeout
Config.Description: When Keep Server Alive is false, stop the dedicated process after this long without human players. Accepts seconds or values such as 10m or 2h.

Config.Name: Game Password
Config.Description: Optional password for browser game data, Play/wake, match status, administration, and WebSocket access. Leave empty for public access.

Config.Name: Password Session Lifetime
Config.Description: Lifetime of an authenticated browser session, for example 30m, 12h, or 48h.

Config.Name: Framework TLS Proxy Trust
Config.Description: Set true only behind a controlled TLS reverse proxy that replaces X-Forwarded-Proto, so password cookies receive the Secure attribute.

Config.Name: Omni-Bot
Config.Description: Set to 1 for automatic bot fill or 0 to disable bots.

Config.Name: RCON Password
Config.Description: Optional dedicated-server RCON password. Leave empty to generate and persist a random password under /data.

Config.Name: Trusted Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 only when a same-host reverse proxy replaces X-Forwarded-For and clients cannot bypass it.

Config.Name: Administrator IPs
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated admin IP allowlist for NAT or proxy setups where automatic same-host detection is insufficient.
